mapper.select: SELECT state.workspace_id AS workspaceId, state.provider, state.stream, state.status, state.error_code AS errorCode, COUNT(*) AS stateCount, SUM(state.stable_cursor IS NOT NULL) AS stableCursorCount, SUM(state.page_cursor IS NOT NULL) AS pageCursorCount, COALESCE(SUM(state.processed_items), 0) AS processedItems, COALESCE(SUM(state.estimated_items), 0) AS estimatedItems, MAX(state.last_attempt_at) AS lastAttemptAt, MAX(state.last_success_at) AS lastSuccessAt, MAX(state.next_attempt_at) AS nextAttemptAt FROM provider_capture_sync_state state JOIN JSON_TABLE( #{orgWorkspaceIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$') ) org_workspace ON org_workspace.id = state.workspace_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE( #{orgWorkspaceIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$') ) anchor_workspace WHERE anchor_workspace.id = #{workspaceId} ) GROUP BY state.workspace_id, state.provider, state.stream, state.status, state.error_code ORDER BY state.workspace_id, state.provider, state.stream, state.status, state.error_code

SELECT workspace_id, provider, allowed, calendar_allowed, mail_inbox_allowed, mail_sent_allowed, max_backfill_days, body_capture_allowed, review_required, exclude_private_events, exclude_internal_only, excluded_domains_json, version, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_capture_workspace_policy WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND provider = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_capture_workspace_policy ( workspace_id, provider, allowed, calendar_allowed, mail_inbox_allowed, mail_sent_allowed, max_backfill_days, body_capture_allowed, review_required, exclude_private_events, exclude_internal_only, excluded_domains_json, version, updated_by_user_id ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{provider}, #{allowed}, #{calendarAllowed}, #{mailInboxAllowed}, #{mailSentAllowed}, #{maxBackfillDays}, #{bodyCaptureAllowed}, #{reviewRequired}, #{excludePrivateEvents}, #{excludeInternalOnly}, #{excludedDomainsJson}, 1, #{updatedByUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_capture_workspace_policy SET allowed = #{policy.allowed}, calendar_allowed = #{policy.calendarAllowed}, mail_inbox_allowed = #{policy.mailInboxAllowed}, mail_sent_allowed = #{policy.mailSentAllowed}, max_backfill_days = #{policy.maxBackfillDays}, body_capture_allowed = #{policy.bodyCaptureAllowed}, review_required = #{policy.reviewRequired}, exclude_private_events = #{policy.excludePrivateEvents}, exclude_internal_only = #{policy.excludeInternalOnly}, excluded_domains_json = #{policy.excludedDomainsJson}, updated_by_user_id = #{policy.updatedByUserId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{policy.workspaceId} AND provider = #{policy.provider} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_capture_user_policy ( workspace_id, user_id, provider, enabled, calendar_enabled, mail_inbox_enabled, mail_sent_enabled, backfill_days, include_bodies, admission_mode, excluded_people_json, excluded_conversations_json, version ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{enabled}, #{calendarEnabled}, #{mailInboxEnabled}, #{mailSentEnabled}, #{backfillDays}, #{includeBodies}, #{admissionMode}, #{excludedPeopleJson}, #{excludedConversationsJson}, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_capture_user_policy SET enabled = #{policy.enabled}, calendar_enabled = #{policy.calendarEnabled}, mail_inbox_enabled = #{policy.mailInboxEnabled}, mail_sent_enabled = #{policy.mailSentEnabled}, backfill_days = #{policy.backfillDays}, include_bodies = #{policy.includeBodies}, admission_mode = #{policy.admissionMode}, excluded_people_json = #{policy.excludedPeopleJson}, excluded_conversations_json = #{policy.excludedConversationsJson}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{policy.workspaceId} AND user_id = #{policy.userId} AND provider = #{policy.provider} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO provider_capture_sync_state ( workspace_id, user_id, provider, stream, credential_generation, status, next_attempt_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{stream}, #{credentialGeneration}, 'idle', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, user_id, provider, stream, credential_generation, status, initial_sync_completed, stable_cursor, page_cursor, lease_owner, lease_until, reconciliation_marker, backfill_started_at, last_attempt_at, last_success_at, next_attempt_at, processed_items, estimated_items, consecutive_failures, error_code, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_capture_sync_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider} ORDER BY stream

SELECT workspace_id, id AS sync_state_id FROM provider_capture_sync_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status IN ('queued', 'retrying', 'idle', 'backfilling', 'syncing') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY (last_attempt_at IS NULL) DESC, COALESCE(last_attempt_at, created_at), COALESCE(next_attempt_at, created_at), id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET status = 'paused', next_attempt_at = NULL, error_code = 'workspace_disabled', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND provider = #{provider}

UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state state JOIN provider_capture_user_policy policy ON policy.workspace_id = state.workspace_id AND policy.user_id = state.user_id AND policy.provider = state.provider SET state.status = 'queued', state.next_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), state.error_code = NULL WHERE state.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND state.provider = #{provider} AND state.status = 'paused' AND policy.enabled = TRUE AND policy.admission_mode <> 'manual'

UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET credential_generation = #{credentialGeneration}, status = 'queued', initial_sync_completed = FALSE, stable_cursor = NULL, page_cursor = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, reconciliation_marker = NULL, backfill_started_at = NULL, next_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), processed_items = 0, estimated_items = NULL, consecutive_failures = 0, error_code = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider} AND credential_generation <> #{credentialGeneration}

UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{until}, last_attempt_at = #{now}, reconciliation_marker = CASE WHEN page_cursor IS NULL AND ( stable_cursor IS NULL OR ( provider = 'microsoft' AND stream = 'calendar' AND stable_cursor = 'microsoft-calendar-full-scan:v1' ) ) THEN UUID() ELSE reconciliation_marker END, backfill_started_at = CASE WHEN page_cursor IS NULL AND ( stable_cursor IS NULL OR ( provider = 'microsoft' AND stream = 'calendar' AND stable_cursor = 'microsoft-calendar-full-scan:v1' ) ) THEN #{now} ELSE backfill_started_at END, status = CASE WHEN initial_sync_completed = FALSE THEN 'backfilling' ELSE 'syncing' END WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('queued', 'retrying', 'idle', 'backfilling', 'syncing') AND next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, user_id, provider, stream, credential_generation, status, initial_sync_completed, stable_cursor, page_cursor, lease_owner, lease_until, reconciliation_marker, backfill_started_at, last_attempt_at, last_success_at, next_attempt_at, processed_items, estimated_items, consecutive_failures, error_code, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_capture_sync_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, workspace_id, user_id, provider, stream, credential_generation, status, initial_sync_completed, stable_cursor, page_cursor, lease_owner, lease_until, reconciliation_marker, backfill_started_at, last_attempt_at, last_success_at, next_attempt_at, processed_items, estimated_items, consecutive_failures, error_code, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_capture_sync_state WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET stable_cursor = #{stableCursor}, page_cursor = #{pageCursor}, status = #{status}, initial_sync_completed = CASE WHEN #{pageCursor} IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE initial_sync_completed END, processed_items = #{processedItems}, estimated_items = #{estimatedItems}, last_success_at = #{lastSuccessAt}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, consecutive_failures = 0, error_code = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, reconciliation_marker = CASE WHEN #{pageCursor} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE reconciliation_marker END, backfill_started_at = CASE WHEN #{pageCursor} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE backfill_started_at END WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET stable_cursor = NULL, page_cursor = NULL, reconciliation_marker = NULL, backfill_started_at = NULL, status = 'retrying', error_code = #{errorCode}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, processed_items = 0, estimated_items = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state SET status = 'paused', error_code = #{errorCode}, next_attempt_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_captured_interaction ( workspace_id, user_id, provider, stream, provider_source_id, provider_conversation_id, source_key_hash, source_version, payload_hash, interaction_type, subject, body, occurred_at, ended_at, visibility, admission_status, admitted_fields_json, material_exclusions_json, policy_version, version, last_seen_reconciliation_marker, tombstoned_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{stream}, #{providerSourceId}, #{providerConversationId}, #{sourceKeyHash}, #{sourceVersion}, #{payloadHash}, #{interactionType}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{occurredAt}, #{endedAt}, #{visibility}, #{admissionStatus}, #{admittedFieldsJson}, #{materialExclusionsJson}, #{policyVersion}, 1, #{lastSeenReconciliationMarker}, #{tombstonedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE activity JOIN provider_activity_projection projection ON projection.workspace_id = activity.workspace_id AND projection.activity_id = activity.id SET activity.provider_captured_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE projection.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND projection.interaction_id = #{interactionId} AND activity.provider_owned = TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM provider_captured_participant WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND interaction_id = #{interactionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_captured_participant ( workspace_id, interaction_id, participant_role, display_name, email, normalized_email, person_id, match_state, held_reason, version ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{interactionId}, #{participantRole}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{normalizedEmail}, #{personId}, #{matchState}, #{heldReason}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, interaction_id, participant_role, display_name, email, normalized_email, person_id, match_state, held_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_captured_participant WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND interaction_id = #{interactionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT review_rows.* FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.workspace_id, p.interaction_id, p.participant_role, p.display_name, p.email, p.normalized_email, p.person_id, p.match_state, p.held_reason, p.version, p.created_at, p.updated_at, i.provider, i.stream, i.interaction_type, i.subject, i.occurred_at, i.version AS interaction_version FROM provider_captured_participant p JOIN provider_captured_interaction i ON i.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND i.id = p.interaction_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.provider = #{provider} AND i.admission_status IN ('held', 'admitted') AND p.match_state IN ('unmatched', 'ambiguous') UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.workspace_id, p.interaction_id, p.participant_role, p.display_name, p.email, p.normalized_email, p.person_id, p.match_state, 'approval_required' AS held_reason, p.version, p.created_at, p.updated_at, i.provider, i.stream, i.interaction_type, i.subject, i.occurred_at, i.version AS interaction_version FROM provider_captured_interaction i JOIN provider_captured_participant p ON p.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND p.interaction_id = i.id AND p.match_state = 'matched' AND p.id = ( SELECT MIN(selected.id) FROM provider_captured_participant selected WHERE selected.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND selected.interaction_id = i.id AND selected.match_state = 'matched' ) WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.provider = #{provider} AND i.admission_status = 'held' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider_captured_participant unresolved WHERE unresolved.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND unresolved.interaction_id = i.id AND unresolved.match_state IN ('unmatched', 'ambiguous') ) ) review_rows ORDER BY review_rows.occurred_at DESC, review_rows.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_captured_interaction i WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.provider = #{provider} AND i.admission_status = 'held' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider_captured_participant p WHERE p.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND p.interaction_id = i.id AND p.match_state = 'matched' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider_captured_participant p WHERE p.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND p.interaction_id = i.id AND p.match_state IN ('unmatched', 'ambiguous') )
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO activity ( workspace_id, type, subject, notes, person_id, deal_id, created_by_id, timestamp, provider_owned, provider_name, provider_stream, provider_source_id, provider_captured_at, provider_visibility, provider_admitted_fields_json, provider_material_exclusions_json, provider_projection_key ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{interaction.interactionType}, COALESCE(#{interaction.subject}, CASE WHEN #{interaction.interactionType} = 'meeting' THEN 'Captured meeting' ELSE 'Captured email' END), #{interaction.body}, #{participant.personId}, NULL, #{actorId}, #{interaction.occurredAt}, TRUE, #{interaction.provider}, #{interaction.stream}, #{interaction.providerSourceId}, #{interaction.capturedAt}, #{interaction.visibility}, #{interaction.admittedFieldsJson}, #{interaction.materialExclusionsJson}, #{projectionKey} )
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET type = #{interaction.interactionType}, subject = COALESCE(#{interaction.subject}, CASE WHEN #{interaction.interactionType} = 'meeting' THEN 'Captured meeting' ELSE 'Captured email' END), notes = #{interaction.body}, person_id = #{participant.personId}, timestamp = #{interaction.occurredAt}, provider_source_id = #{interaction.providerSourceId}, provider_captured_at = #{interaction.capturedAt}, provider_visibility = #{interaction.visibility}, provider_admitted_fields_json = #{interaction.admittedFieldsJson}, provider_material_exclusions_json = #{interaction.materialExclusionsJson} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND provider_projection_key = #{projectionKey} AND provider_owned = TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM activity a JOIN provider_activity_projection projection ON projection.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND projection.activity_id = a.id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND projection.interaction_id = #{interactionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND provider_projection_key = #{projectionKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM activity a JOIN provider_activity_projection projection ON projection.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND projection.activity_id = a.id JOIN provider_captured_participant restricted_participant ON restricted_participant.workspace_id = projection.workspace_id AND restricted_participant.id = projection.participant_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND restricted_participant.person_id = #{personId}
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_captured_interaction interaction JOIN provider_captured_participant participant ON participant.workspace_id = interaction.workspace_id AND participant.interaction_id = interaction.id SET interaction.admission_status = 'held', interaction.version = interaction.version + 1 WHERE interaction.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND participant.person_id = #{personId} AND interaction.admission_status = 'admitted'

UPDATE provider_captured_participant SET person_id = NULL, match_state = 'unmatched', held_reason = 'restricted_person', version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_id = #{personId}

UPDATE provider_captured_participant participant JOIN person_identity identity ON identity.workspace_id = participant.workspace_id AND identity.kind = 'email' AND identity.normalized_value = participant.normalized_email AND identity.person_id = #{personId} AND identity.superseded_at IS NULL SET participant.held_reason = 'no_match', participant.version = participant.version + 1 WHERE participant.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND participant.held_reason = 'restricted_person'
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM activity a JOIN provider_activity_projection projection ON projection.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND projection.activity_id = a.id JOIN provider_captured_interaction interaction ON interaction.workspace_id = projection.workspace_id AND interaction.id = projection.interaction_id WHERE interaction.user_id = #{userId} AND interaction.provider = #{provider}

DELETE a FROM activity a JOIN provider_activity_projection projection ON projection.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND projection.activity_id = a.id JOIN provider_captured_interaction interaction ON interaction.workspace_id = projection.workspace_id AND interaction.id = projection.interaction_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND interaction.provider = #{provider}

mapper.update: UPDATE provider_capture_sync_state state JOIN provider_capture_user_policy policy ON policy.workspace_id = state.workspace_id AND policy.user_id = state.user_id AND policy.provider = state.provider SET state.status = CASE WHEN policy.enabled = FALSE THEN 'paused' WHEN policy.admission_mode = 'manual' THEN 'idle' ELSE 'queued' END, state.stable_cursor = NULL, state.page_cursor = NULL, state.lease_owner = NULL, state.lease_until = NULL, state.reconciliation_marker = NULL, state.backfill_started_at = NULL, state.next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN policy.enabled = TRUE AND policy.admission_mode <> 'manual' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, state.processed_items = 0, state.estimated_items = NULL, state.consecutive_failures = 0, state.error_code = CASE WHEN policy.enabled = FALSE THEN 'policy_disabled' ELSE NULL END WHERE state.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND state.provider = #{provider}
